mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate reached 5.33% in August 2023
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.7% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.7%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1,450,000 units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts higher future consumption and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.8 index points signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 100.8, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based demand expansion, which signals rising corporate revenues and earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS declined to 684,755M in August 2023, but INDPRO fell to 100.8
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and INDPRO fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stagnant or declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflationary pressures, prompting the Fed to maintain high rates while growth weakens, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:CPIAUCSL was 306.082 in August 2023, INDPRO was 100.8393
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 306.0 and INDPRO < 101.0, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market tightening, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to a Fed policy response that suppresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS was 156,261K in August 2023, UNRATE was 3.7%
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when PAYEMS > 156,000 and UNRATE < 3.8%, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 22,500 billion chained dollars signals strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of cases when GDPC1 > 22,500, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
